name: contract-expected-failure-cases
goal: Expected-failure runner modifiers cannot count as passing standard cases

evidence: Discovery rejects skips and exclusive cases but treats Vitest fails modifiers as ordinary coverage. Such a modifier inverts a broken assertion into a successful runner result instead of asserting the error in the responsible case.
The existing scan case exercised skip and computed registration but no expected-failure modifier. Strengthen the same source matrix without adding a test declaration.
